title: Preserve SOURCE_DEBT provenance across dependent recovery jobs
mission: Close the generic recovery hole where a dependent wrapper job reaches BOUNDARY/ROUTE_ABORTED because another durable artifact/job has already proven structured SOURCE_DEBT, but the dependent return itself carries neither structured source_debt nor an explicit machine-readable dependency. Add the smallest generic provenance/gating mechanism so time alone cannot reopen the dependent job while the referenced debt is unchanged. Preserve EFF029 semantics, unresolved recovery_attention, ordinary stale-owner recovery, and claim-first performance. Do not hardcode Jose job IDs, parse arbitrary prose, or recursively crawl unrelated evidence.
definition_of_done: A regression fixture reproduces the observed dependent-job loop: the payload/base64 wrapper reaches a nonterminal boundary because the pinned V11 material-recovery debt is OPEN, then elapsed time would otherwise expose another generation.

The dependent job receives or resolves an explicit machine-readable SOURCE_DEBT provenance link sufficient for recoveryBasisGate to suppress time-only G+1 without job-specific IDs or free-text heuristics.
The unresolved dependent job remains visible in recovery_attention with exact debt/basis provenance instead of becoming terminal or disappearing from attention.
A materially new durable source/evidence/capability/retry-safe basis after the referenced debt re-enables one deterministic next generation and stamps its basis provenance.
Existing same-job structured SOURCE_DEBT handling, ordinary silent-owner stale recovery, fixed-generation semantics, authority gates, and candidate ordering remain unchanged.
Live/feed, live/allocator and compact claim-frontier projections are covered so the dependent debt is non-claimable but still observable.
No arbitrary recursive evidence traversal is introduced in the allocator hot path; provenance is bounded and explicit.
Relevant SOURCE_DEBT, allocator and efficiency-ratchet tests pass in repository runtime.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or production /w authority is promoted.
